newsitem.title: UK: C&W up on HK Telecom stake speculation.
newsitem.headline: C&W up on HK Telecom stake speculation.

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless Plc rose on Wednesday, lifted by gains in HK Telecom amid talk that C&W's 58.5-percent owned HK unit is seeking a mainland Chinese investor, dealers said.
C&W shares were up 14-1/2p at 496-1/2 by 1429 GMT in volume of just over five million shares.
Dealers said talk of a Chinese investor in HK Telecom was not new but had resurfaced ahead of the end of British rule in the territory in July.
No-one at C&W was immediately available for comment.
In Hong Kong, HK Telecom on Wednesday rose 10 HK cents to $HK14.20.
